UPDATE groups SET
                   total_media_counter = total_media_counter + 1,
                   last_flame_counter_change = ?,
                   last_message_received = ?,
                   last_message_send = ?,
                   flame_counter = ?,
                   max_flame_counter = ?,
                   max_flame_counter_from = ?
               WHERE group_id = ?
